subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should `capabilities.tts.voice.captionedFinalText` be accepted as the supported cross-channel plugin contract for core to suppress live reply text and rely on a final voice-note caption?
rationale: This changes the plugin SDK and delivery semantics for every future channel that opts in; source tests can validate mechanics but cannot choose the permanent public contract or its intended ownership boundary.

options.title: Adopt the capability contract
options.body: Accept `captionedFinalText` as the explicit opt-in seam, subject to exact-head Telegram proof and focused compatibility coverage.

options.title: Keep the behavior Telegram-owned
options.body: Avoid the new core capability and pursue any Telegram-specific presentation behavior within the Telegram plugin if the shared contract is not desired.

options.title: Pause pending API design
options.body: Hold the PR until channel/plugin owners define the supported caption and fallback contract for other voice-note channels.

recommendation.title: Adopt the capability contract
recommendation.body: Accept `captionedFinalText` as the explicit opt-in seam, subject to exact-head Telegram proof and focused compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The available timeline shows direct early engagement, while the supplied data provides no stronger feature-history owner.
